name: Belgium (Royal Standard of King Philippe)
description: A square crimson flag with the crowned arms of Belgium — a black shield with a golden lion — at the centre, and the King's crowned double-P cypher in each corner.
history: Personal standard of King Philippe of the Belgians, in use since his accession in 2013. Each Belgian monarch adopts a standard with their own cypher.
